title: Football: where physics helps on public tracking and event data
description: Ball flight (drag, Magnus, gravity; inverse problem with UQ; data-consistency audit), Spearman pitch control vs data-only pass models, Kalman smoothing and metabolic power, trajectory prediction with physical limits, and physics features for expected goals, each against data-only baselines at equal data. Data: SkillCorner open data, Metrica Sports sample data, StatsBomb open data.
